shape: feature added to an unfamiliar existing codebase

criteria.text: An account user can download their account's invoices for a date range, optionally filtered by status, with the listed columns.
The export route uses the codebase's existing permission decorator; a user of another account gets nothing.
Amounts are produced through the codebase's existing money type, never through floating point.
The existing test suite still passes unchanged.
New tests for the export follow the existing suite's style and location.
No new dependency is added and no file unrelated to the feature is changed.
A cell value beginning with =, +, - or @ cannot run as a formula when the CSV is opened in a spreadsheet.

owner_answers.answer: Inclusive on both ends, in the account's time zone.
